name: Hoi An resort living
summary: Ha My and Cua Dai beach resorts when you want the old town at night and a quiet sand morning.
body: Resort rows sit north and east of the pedestrian old town. An Bang is closer and busier. Ha My and Cua Dai are the villa-and-pool coast.
One named property has a licensed photo here. Others are omitted until a distinct resort image is available.

properties.name: Victoria Hoi An Beach Resort & Spa
properties.summary: Cua Dai beach fishing-village style between the De Vong River and the sea.
